agents.name: Geometry operations agent
agents.purpose: Expose contract kernel operations (extrude, booleans, tessellation) to an agent loop with budgets and cancellation.
agents.input_schema: JSON Schema, object type, declared in crates/cad-agent-geometry/src/lib.rs#input_schema: op (enum), profile (array of [x,y], 3..4096 points), profile_file (1..128 chars), height_mm (0.001..100000), operation (union|intersection|difference), a|b|solid (integer >= 1), chord_tol_mm (0.0001..10).
agents.output_schema: JSON Schema, object type, declared in crates/cad-agent-geometry/src/lib.rs#output_schema: op, ok, solid, triangles, vertices, open_edges, volume_mm3, area_mm2, min, max. Measurements only, never geometry.
agents.resources: One kernel instance for the agent's lifetime, behind a mutex. Call budget 10,000; output cap 8 KiB; wall clock 30 s per call. Profile reads are capped at 1 MiB and 4096 points.
limitations: Boolean difference is refused: the truck adapter does not advertise it, so the agent reports it as unsupported rather than returning a wrong solid.
Solid handles are session handles and must never be persisted.
The reply carries measurements only, so a caller cannot obtain a mesh through the agent.
The workspace read is one JSON profile file; no other format is imported and no file is written.
Cancellation is cooperative: a single pathological boolean inside truck cannot be interrupted mid-call.
agents.disable_procedure: Remove crates/cad-agent-geometry from the workspace members and the repository, module and capability entries from the manifests. No other crate depends on it, so nothing else changes.

agents.name: Import/export agent
agents.purpose: Convert CAD files inside a confined workspace with size and entity budgets.
limitations: The CadAgent contract and runtime now exist (crates/cad-agent-api, crates/cad-agent-runtime), so an import agent has a contract to declare and a host to run in. What is still missing is the agent itself and the import budgets in SolidCraft IO (security S-3).
